edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Shapesplitter banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Q-poking with the E banked forever — the root is the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
